unproved_scope_limits.statement: Only captured nonnull URL/HTML/Reload returns and accepted nonnull starts populate weak membership. Discarded Back/Forward return values and unmatched terminal/commit callbacks are not registered.

A callback before its initiating native call returns may carry a genuinely unseen handle. Under reentrant replacement, current source authority cannot prove whether such a handle is older issued work or a new native link.

FinishedCommitted→loading=true KVO→SuspendedCommitted→Stop→later unseen start is not covered by the bound-record Stop barrier. Assigning that Stop to an arbitrary next unseen token could reject a genuinely later link; loading=false provides no identity. No such actual SDK ordering was observed by this review.
SuspendedCommitted is not recertified by loading=false. Idle same-document KVO is source-preserved; same-document native-loading cycles and arbitrary callback/KVO order are not proven.

Null issued returns remain no-op bindings without commit authority. Completion of a native no-op Reload returning null is not proven. An unbound AwaitingStart record with an existing Stop flag still refuses an unseen start; no universal unseen-start guarantee for unidentified/nil-return stopped records is asserted.

NSHashTable constructor/symbol types, native weak zeroing/object-pointer personality behavior, native WKNavigation callback identity, Kotlin compilation and real selected request2 all still require platform verification. Local author metadata/source/control receipts are not that verification.
